name: Frank Horche
headline: Founder | Passionate Leader | Tech Enthusiast | ex-Accenture | ex-Allianz | ex-KONUX | ex-CGM
summary:
I'm a leader of IT and software product organizations leveraging data & analytics with 20 years of relevant experience. I'm strongly self-organized and driven by a focussed entrepreneurial and analytical mindset, highly experienced in strategic planning, scaling and transformation execution, and stakeholder management.

I have led organizations of up the 150 FTE and was responsible for P&Ls up to EUR 25m ARR. I have a proven track-record in Leadership, Product, Engineering, IT, Operations and Finance and as Managing Director. My sweet spot is at bridging the gap between business and technology.

Currently I'm building a company in the financial industry, bootstrapped, no VC, maximum AI leverage.

positions.title: Managing Director
positions.description: Creating the next level of my professional life, currently working in stealth mode.

positions.title: Geschäftsführer ifap GmbH | General Manager @ CompuGroup Medical SE
positions.description: At CompuGroup Medical (CGM), I was leading an eHealth business unit providing software products to >60.000 healthcare practitioners in Germany with more than EUR 20m ARR. I have restructured the organization and scaled it from 60 to 100 FTE, renewing the legacy product portfolio and building new highly scalable SaaS products by leveraging big data & analytics under Medical Device Regulation (MDR). Set up the company for growth and strong profitability.

positions.title: Head of Operations & Security
positions.description: At KONUX (a IoT/AI SaaS startup), I was setting up and scaling the Global Operations function including hiring people, implementing processes and tools. The result was a highly scalable, resilient and secure cloud infrastructure aligned with ISO27001 standards. The Service Operations team was able to identify and resolve issues before the customer would recognize them.

positions.title: Head of Global Platforms for HRIT and Document Management
positions.description: At Allianz Technology, I was leading a department with five teams in three international locations, scaling from 60 to 120 FTE in order to build, roll-out and manage the global HR SaaS solution for the >140.000 employees of the Allianz Group in 30 countries. I was accountable for the P&L of EUR 25m ARR.

positions.title: Senior Manager IT Transformation and Strategy
positions.description: At Accenture, I was leading various international software development teams (up to 150 FTE) for clients in the telecommunications industry, transforming their CRM and Billing application stacks. In addition, I was consulting CIOs to transform their IT organizations and closed a USD 100m transformational outsourcing deal with a major client in Germany.
